label: Access
short: The percentage of staff with a paid AI plan bought by the organisation (bundled Workspace or 365 features excluded).
strong: Bought plans cover at least two-thirds of staff. The question is what they are used for: see Spread.
middle: Bought plans cover 1–66% of staff. Others use personal accounts, bundled features or no AI tool. The guide to verification and safety at work says what may go in; decide the rest from that.
edge: No bought plan. Free tiers and bundled features can handle public material. Personal accounts need clear data rules. An organisation that pays for API use but buys no staff plans is a separate case. Start with the guide to verification and safety at work.
unmet: Ask whoever pays the invoices. A plan is either bought or not.
